title: When doubt keeps fogging the path as a steady practice
issueStatement: The mind keeps second-guessing what it once knew clearly enough to begin. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru answers doubt by clarifying what is worth trusting, keeping, and repeating. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: Stop circling and let Guru's word take residence. Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once.
actionPrompt: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Repeat what you can actually keep.
